records.claim: Actual tokenizer measurements bracket full-history rejection and admitted fallback after all six admitted prefix templates at 8K, 10K and 12K. Both original facts exist in full history and neither exists in the fallback template. 54 tokenizer attempts, zero model calls.
limitations: Support is for the token-only feasibility experiment, not the full H22 semantic prediction.
Templates derive from scripted tool trajectories; no live GLM pressure trajectory has run.
The neutral padding adapter and real per-request measurements must be bound again for live use.

records.next_action: Construct the controlled H22 pressure episode with the exact neutral padding adapter and current measured constants; verify actual per-request admission and fact delivery before a separately frozen live model study. The full H22 semantic claim remains untested.
